response.original_title: I tracked down the thief who stole $200,000 of LEGO
response.overview: In this video, I got an email from a fan saying their dad had spent his entire life collecting Star Wars lego sets, and now it's known to be the world's largest Star Wars lego collection ever worth around $200,000.  However, the entire thing got stolen from him by a lego company called "Bricks and Minifigs."  We basically try to nicely ask for his property back, and they said no, so it looks like we have to get it back the hard way! Enjoy!
response.title: I tracked down the thief who stole $200,000 of LEGO
